sources.title: Huihui gemma 4 31B it abliterated v2 NVFP4 — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A fine-tuned, abliterated variant of Google's Gemma 4 31B, meaning its built-in refusal behaviors have been removed to allow more unconstrained responses. It accepts both text and image inputs, giving it multimodal awareness. As a community-modified open-weight release, it trades safety guardrails for fewer restrictions, which is a deliberate trade-off rather than an oversight.
